Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Bars
Punchline: Show or hide hotbars depending on your class or job.
Description:
Show or hide hotbars depending on your class or job. Pick a hotbar, choose "Show only on" or "Hide on", and click the jobs it applies to. More hotbar magic is in the works!

Open the settings with /willobars.
Changelog:
- Edit rules in a popout beside the main window and tidy the status card
- Rules with cases and conditions like combat, weather, zone and duty
- Keep "Will-o-Bars" together when text wraps
- Don't reread every backup file after saving or deleting one
- Read the saved settings folder every few seconds instead of every frame
- Stop retrying a hotbar the game keeps changing back
